newsitem.title: USA: Fine Host in two acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: Fine Host in two acquisitions.

text.p: Fine Host Corp said on Tuesday it completed the acquisition PCS Corp, a privately held contract food services company, and reached an agreement in principle to purchase a contract food management company.
PCS Corp, headquartered in North Carolina, generates an estimated $18 million in annual revenues. The company provides non-patient food and ancillary management services to hospitals.
The unnamed food service management company, based in New York state, generates an estimated $34 million in annual revenues. It provides food service to college and corporate dining markets.
Fine Host, with annual revenues of $95 million in 1995, is a contract food service management company.
A Fine Host spokesman decliend to give further details on the acquisitions, but added that both transactions were cash deals.
